$comment: Hand-written at adoption on 2026-11-10 because `nen shu detect` answered `no lane detected`: this repository is a single self-contained HTML page assembled by Python (src/build.py) and structurally checked by Python (src/verify.py), which is none of nen's reference stacks. The `dependency` block is copied from Hatsu's own contract at its pinned build and moves only at a repin. The `project` block declares exactly what the Makefile already runs; every verb the repository does not have is an explicit seat with its reason, never an omission.

test.unsupported: No test suite exists; src/verify.py's structural checks on the generated page run as `lint`.

ui-test.unsupported: No UI or end-to-end suite exists for the static page.

coverage.unsupported: No test suite exists, so there is nothing to measure coverage of.

archive.unsupported: The distributable is the committed index.html that `build` regenerates; no separate archive step exists.

run.unsupported: There is no production start: the page is opened directly or served over the LAN by `dev`.

deploy.unsupported: No deploy destination has been chosen; the page is served locally over the LAN.

release.unsupported: No publication destination has been chosen; nothing here publishes a release.

python3.why: src/build.py and src/verify.py run on the system Python; nen never installs a host toolchain.
